chunks: And the Commander of the Faithful, may the prayers of Allah be upon him, said:
"A sword is like a garment; you may perform salat (prayer) with it so long as you do not see blood on it. And the bow is like a garment."

key_terms.الرِّدَاءِ: a garment or cloak, used as the comparison for legal treatment in prayer
key_terms.السَّيْفُ: the sword, treated here as an item whose state affects the validity of salat (prayer)
key_terms.الْقَوْسُ: the bow, likewise treated as a garment in this ruling
key_terms.بِمَنْزِلَةِ: in the position or ruling of, meaning legally analogous to
key_terms.دَمًا: blood, whose visible presence affects permissibility in this context

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to perform salat (prayer) while carrying a sword or a bow?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning items worn or carried in salat (prayer), treating the sword and the bow like garments. It indicates that prayer with them is valid so long as visible blood is not present on the sword.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.758 - The Commander of the Faithful Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as) said:
"A sword is like a garment; you may pray with it as long as you do not see any blood on it. A bow is also like a garment."
